findings.violated_claim: Candidate boundary claims embedded Safari companion extension but SPM SwiftUI app does not embed .appex
findings.evidence: build-app.sh creates PLUGINS_DIR but never populates it; SPM Package.swift has no extension target
findings.required_repair: Update build-app.sh to build extension via xcodebuild and embed into SPM app's PlugIns

findings.violated_claim: _diagnostics.py docstring claims FAIL-CLOSED but code always returns DiagnosticBundle
findings.evidence: _diagnostics.py lines 1-12 claim fail-closed; lines 305-312 always return a bundle even with violations
findings.required_repair: Add actual refusal path: raise DiagnosticExportBlocked exception

findings.violated_claim: _evidence_hash.py claims canonical artifact-manifest digest but produces raw SHA256 with no framing
findings.evidence: _evidence_hash.py uses raw concatenation with no schema version or record framing

findings.violated_claim: Safari companion handoff corridor is integrated into product app
